titles.name: DREAM VINE
titles.tagline: An original block-building sandbox. Explore endless worlds, mine, craft, build and survive the night.
titles.description: DREAM VINE is an original block-building sandbox game by EX Inc. Explore endless procedurally generated worlds, mine, craft and build, survive the night, or fly around freely in Creative. All code, textures, names, mobs and logos are original, and everything is generated procedurally.

9-slot hotbar, 27-slot inventory and crafting: tools from wood to diamond, glass, bricks, Dream Vine blocks

Play as ANA and DANIEL, switch between them at any time, take any car with F, enter street races and activities, and GET WANTED: outrun the police as your wanted stars climb. Customise your ride at FRGARAGE, go home to Ana and Daniel's house to sleep, save and change outfits, and use the EX IX G9 phone to call a JP Taxi. Seasonal FESTIVAL feed (UTC weeks): Spring sakura, Summer night races, Autumn drifts, Winter run — race, photo and drive-to events with rewards

titles.description: THE ANULMENT (Chapter 1: The Annulled Vote) is a story game set at night in the fictional country of Valdora. The Constitutional Court has annulled the first round of the presidential election and charged its winner, CLN. You play MIYOYAZU, an ordinary blogger in a grey hoodie: join the peaceful protest at the court, photograph and recover evidence, interview the prosecutors' aide and publish the truth. All characters, parties, countries and events in this game are fictional. Publisher: EX Inc./HYPERION DIGITAL. ©2026 EX Inc./HYPERION DIGITAL ©2026.

Play a 6-mission voiced campaign: basic training on the range and the obstacle course, the kill house, night ops, defending the camp against waves, a convoy escort and the final assault on the east compound. In COKA ONLINE you play Team Deathmatch 6v6 or Free-for-all against named AI bots. Earn XP, rank up from Recruit to Commander, and unlock fictional weapons, attachments, digital camos and perks. Run, jump, double-jump and dash, collect coins, reach the goal arch, and chase ranks by time and coin count. Challenge ramps from teaching stages to tight late-game platforms and long gaps. Some stages add a light twist — TIME VEIL, GIANT STEP, LIGHT FALL, SKY FLIP or RUSH WIND. Romantic rose and gold UI, filmic colour grade and grain, RTX / EX HD modes, no bloom.
